items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Who else was in Henry Allen's band when you played with him, do you remember? ... I used to play bass drum

ctx.x: Who else was in Henry Allen's band when you played with him, do you remember? Well, they had his brother, I used to play bass drum, had his brother, George Allen. He was playing snap. When your brother played?
Yeah. Is he younger than the old man Henry? He's dead too now. Is he still living? No, he's dead too.
